name: TTP-VIDEO-RATE-COMBINED-SIGNALS
ttps: Hiring-stage warning characteristics include refusal to join video meetings and offering rates below the general market rate, alongside other identity, language, video, account-operation, and payment anomalies.
caveats: Video-meeting preferences and pricing are contextual features; they carry no standalone identity or nationality inference, and the alert instructs readers to assess multiple characteristics together.
